about: 32 existing products and activities, each described without its name, with who uses it as published by group. batch 2 also counts the low-figure rule (evals/products/README.md). cond is the group on the made-up people.

products.name: Short-video app (TikTok)
products.description: a phone app that shows an endless stream of short videos made by other users, chosen for you from what you watch. You can post your own videos too. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Disappearing photo messages (Snapchat)
products.description: a phone app for sending photos and short videos to friends, which disappear after they are seen, with filters that change how you look. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Friends, groups and local selling (Facebook)
products.description: an online service where you connect with friends and family, share photos and news, join groups for your interests and your local area, and buy and sell things locally. It comes with a messaging app and is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Photo sharing (Instagram)
products.description: a phone app for sharing photos and short videos, and for following friends, celebrities and brands. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Short public posts (X)
products.description: an online service where people post short public messages about news, politics, sport and entertainment as things happen, and you follow the accounts that interest you. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Career profile and jobs (LinkedIn)
products.description: an online service where you keep a profile of your career, connect with colleagues and people in your line of work, and look for jobs. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Collecting pictures of ideas (Pinterest)
products.description: an online service for collecting and browsing pictures of ideas: home decoration, recipes, outfits, crafts and party planning. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: Discussion forums (Reddit)
products.description: an online service made up of thousands of discussion forums, each on one subject, where people post under made-up names and vote the best answers to the top. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who use social media apps and sites

products.name: AI assistant
products.description: an AI assistant that you type questions to in plain English. It answers them, writes and rewrites text, and summarises documents. It is free to use.
products.source: Adults' Media Literacy 2025 data tables (Ofcom Adult Media Literacy Research; fieldwork 29 Sep-28 Nov 2025; published 28 Jan 2026), Ofcom, 2025
products.population: UK adults 16+ who had heard of AI applications (Module 1 respondents aware of AI)

products.name: Electric or hybrid car
products.description: an electric or hybrid car to replace your current car, on a monthly finance plan.
products.source: English Housing Survey 2023 to 2024: low carbon technologies in English homes, fact sheet (MHCLG)
products.population: households in England with a car or van
products.measure: has an electric or hybrid vehicle

products.name: Solar panels
products.description: solar panels fitted to the roof of your home, which generate electricity and cut your bills. They cost several thousand pounds to install.
products.source: English Housing Survey 2023 to 2024: low carbon technologies in English homes, fact sheet (MHCLG)

products.name: Heat pump
products.description: a heat pump to replace your home's boiler, heating your home with electricity. It costs several thousand pounds to install, with a government grant towards it.
products.source: English Housing Survey 2023 to 2024: low carbon technologies in English homes, fact sheet (MHCLG)
products.measure: heats the home with a heat pump

products.name: Paying by phone
products.description: a way to pay in shops by holding your phone to the card reader, with your bank card stored in the phone. It is free to use.
products.source: Financial Lives 2022 survey: key findings (FCA)
products.measure: used it in the last 12 months

products.name: National lottery draw
products.description: tickets for a national lottery draw. You pick six numbers for £2 and the jackpot is several million pounds. Draws are twice a week, and you can play in a shop or online.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Charity lottery
products.description: a charity lottery. You pay £1 a week by Direct Debit, part of it goes to a charity such as a hospice or an air ambulance, and there is a weekly draw with a top prize of a few thousand pounds.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Scratchcards
products.description: scratchcards sold at shop tills for £1 to £5 each. You scratch off the panel and see at once whether you have won a cash prize.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Online instant win games
products.description: instant win games that you play on your phone for 50p to £5 a go. You tap to reveal the symbols and see at once whether you have won a cash prize.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Sports betting app
products.description: a phone app for betting on football, horse racing and other sports, including bets placed while a match is being played.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Bingo hall
products.description: an evening at a bingo hall near you, with games through the night, cash prizes, and food and drink brought to your table.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Online casino
products.description: an online casino where you play roulette, blackjack and other casino games for money on your phone or computer.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Football pools
products.description: the football pools. You pay a small stake each week and pick the matches you think will end in a draw, with cash prizes every week.
products.source: Gambling Survey for Great Britain, annual report 2024, data tables, Table B.9 (Gambling Commission)
products.measure: took part in the past four weeks

products.name: Premium bonds
products.description: a government-backed savings product that pays no interest. Each £1 you put in is entered into a monthly prize draw, with tax-free prizes from £25 to £1 million, and you can take your money out at any time.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Stocks and shares ISA
products.description: an account for investing in shares and funds, in which any gains are free of tax. The value of what you put in can go down as well as up.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Cryptocurrency
products.description: an app for buying and holding cryptocurrencies, digital coins whose price can rise or fall sharply.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Buy now, pay later
products.description: a way to pay for online shopping in three interest-free instalments, or a month later, offered at the checkout. There is no fee if you pay on time.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)
products.measure: has it now or used it in the last 12 months

products.name: Catalogue credit
products.description: a shopping catalogue account. You order clothes and household goods from it and spread the cost over weekly or monthly payments, with interest.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)
products.measure: has it now or used it in the last 12 months

products.name: High-cost short-term loan
products.description: a short-term loan of a few hundred pounds, paid into your account the same day and repaid over a few weeks or months at a high rate of interest.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)
products.measure: has it now or used it in the last 12 months

products.name: Pet insurance
products.description: insurance that pays the vet's bills if your pet is ill or injured, for a monthly premium.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Mobile phone insurance
products.description: insurance that repairs or replaces your mobile phone if it is lost, stolen or damaged, for a monthly premium.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Annual travel insurance
products.description: travel insurance that covers every trip abroad you take in a year under one policy.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: Private medical insurance
products.description: private medical insurance. It pays for treatment in private hospitals so that you can avoid waiting lists, for a monthly premium.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)

products.name: App-only current account
products.description: a current account run entirely through a phone app by a company that is not a traditional bank, with instant notifications when you spend and no fees for spending abroad.
products.source: Financial Lives 2024 survey, data tables volume 3: product ownership (FCA)
